1) CMRG, 리오틴토와 철광석 연간 공급계약 합의

sources.title: CMRG agrees to new annual supply contract with Rio Tinto, sources say
evidence: China's state iron ore buyer has agreed a new supply deal for the key steelmaking ingredient with Rio Tinto
China Mineral Resources Group (CMRG) verbally notified some steel mills of the agreement on Wednesday
CMRG will start on Thursday to collect information on volumes that each mill needs to buy from the miner
It was not immediately clear how much Rio Tinto iron ore would be allocated under the contract.

sources.title: First Quantum’s Kansanshi expansion beats design capacity
evidence: First Quantum Minerals’ (TSX: FM) $1.2 billion Kansanshi expansion in Zambia is on track to process 8% more ore
The operation is expected to process about 27 million tonnes of ore this year,
exceeding the new plant’s annual design capacity of 25 million tonnes, the company said Wednesday.
First Quantum has forecast Kansanshi copper production of 175,000 to 205,000 tonnes in 2026,
